body: So me and dagoldbrick were in ts when ts.avicus.net was down this was around 2:50AM BST and we were just memeing about right and so he dared me to say "KYS" to see if I would get banned and it actually fucking worked lol. I would just like to say you can check the logs nobody was cussing me or anything and I didn't provoke anybody.  I said it to nobody and just said it in chat NOT DIRECTED TO ANYBODY you can ask dagoldbrick. We were basically trying to see what would happen and it actually worked. I couldn't manage to record it but I promise you I did not mean IT TO ANYBODY I just said in chat to see what would actually happen. It was hillarious but I think it just goes to shows how the mods are good at their jobs. Seniors please check the logs lol I didn't do anything you can check everything on chat. If you don't believe me I also have proof that me and brick were in ts. You can ask brick I swear I didn't say kys to anybody he dared me for the lols to see if it would actually work and it did. DaBaderMc I would just like to say that you need to double check your reports lol I did not say KYS to anyone. Check the logs I will 100% gurantee you I didn't. I That's the only thing I typed in chat. Seniors you need to check out your mods honestly get me into support or some shit beacuse DaBaderMc made a bad choice.

title: banned for kys even tho not directed

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

Although your comment may have been a joke, there was actually a user ingame who reported you and did seem somewhat alerted by that comment, so it may not have been directed but it still had an impact. A dare is no reason to type a message that can have the chance of affecting anyone. In the future, please be careful about what you type in chat and mind that there are many people on the server who could be going through things in real life that they don't wish to be reminded about. This may seem like a bit much, but we don't really take these things lightly. As for now, this is denied.

Firstly I'd just like to clarify that saying KYS, despite if it is directed or not, is not tolerated at all. However, only recently has the Senior Staff Updated the punishment guidelines to death threats, so consider yourself lucky. Don't let this happen again. Appealed. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Administrator
